policy: AI visuals are illustrative reconstructions or conceptual illustrations, never documentary footage or evidence. Former Taman Festival is a historical reconstruction before 2026 redevelopment. Renderer overlays REKA ADEGAN • ILUSTRASI AI; never ask the image model to render text.
